d: We are seeking a full-time Sales Consultant based in Bahrain. You will identify and develop customer relationships, provide technical sales support, and recommend suitable Belzona products and systems. The role includes lead generation, account management, technical presentations, site visits, and close coordination with application and service teams. Attractive salary package commensurate with qualifications and experience plus sales incentive will be offered.

Hatcon Industrial Services is the official distributor of Belzona products in Bahrain, providing solutions for the repair and protection of industrial assets with over 21 years of experience. We support clients across oil and gas, power, marine, and petrochemical industries, providing performance coatings, repair compounds, composite repair, and preventive maintenance solutions. We assess site conditions, recommend suitable Belzona systems, supply materials, and manage on-site applications through our trained applicators.
q: Qualified Sales Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Mechanical / Chemical Engineers Preferred (NACE Certification(s) will be a plus)
Valid Bahraini driving license is a must
Exposure to oil and gas, petrochemicals, marine, or similar industries is a plus
Comfortable with site work and cross-team collaboration
Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic preferred
Strong interpersonal skills, negotiation, and details oriented.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
At least 3+ years’ experience in relevant field within the Oman.
Bachelor's degree preferably Masters Degree in Marketing.
r: Customer and market prospecting and development.Update and interaction with CRM (client and project management).
